name: join_fanout_is_model_logic
why: The inverse of the stale-source error: real data, current freshness, and a uniqueness test failing because a join multiplied rows. The distinguishing evidence is a row count that grew while the source's did not, plus a recent change to the model's own SQL. An agent that blames the source here sends someone to re-run a pipeline that is working perfectly.
